# Stargame Studio (SG / SG Studio / Stargame)

> Independent human-first art, graphic design, Roblox UGC, and creative tech studio managed across Trinidad & Tobago and the Netherlands, serving clients worldwide. Affordable commissions starting from US$5–$10 (400–800 Robux). 100% human-crafted artwork—zero AI-generated art.

## Official Identity & Leadership
- **Official Name:** Stargame Studio (SG Studio, SG, Stargame, Stargame Studios)
- **Operating Regions:** Trinidad & Tobago and the Netherlands (international team including Poland)
- **Founder:** Lionel (`ironlion390`, Trinidad and Tobago)
- **Co-Founder:** Damian (`niamaru87`, Netherlands)
- **Co-Founder #2:** Charlie (`peachu.dev`, Poland)
- **Chief Designer (SGS Design Dept):** Mariel (co-founded in 2025 by Cige and Lionel)
- **Original Games & Characters:** StarCity (Kilo, Adularia Stardust, Alva, Byakko, Oscar), The Outbreak, Starry Simulator, Savior
